title: Exact sparse inference instead of an amortized SAE encoder
description: Learn the feature dictionary with the method of optimal directions: infer codes by orthogonal matching pursuit, then solve the dictionary in closed form by least squares. An SAE's linear encoder must pick active features in one shot, and when a child feature only fires with its parent it can fold the child into the parent's latent (absorption). Exact per-sample inference explains each activation with whichever atoms jointly fit it best, so child directions should be recovered more cleanly.
